stem: ![](asset:P000250-stem-1)Two particles are projected simultaneously as shown with B being vertically above A. What should be height of projection of particle B, if the two particles collide at C (just before they hit the ground).

assets.alt: From A on the ground, a ball is projected at 10 m/s at 60° above the horizontal. From B, at height h directly above A, a ball is thrown horizontally at 5 m/s. Both dashed paths end at C on the ground.
A ball from A (10 m/s at 60°) and a ball thrown horizontally at 5 m/s from B, height h above A; both land at C.
